description: S468 fix round 1: a render-time call to a server function in a markup `${ … }` interpolation OUTSIDE any `<errorBoundary>` is a server call in a value position and is E-VALUE-SERVER-CALL (§13.7). impl#1 emits the code only for a server call an `<errorBoundary>` would otherwise handle (server-fn/error-boundary-value-server-call-neg, which this case replaces as the pin of the carried gap); here it still compiles at exit 0.
rationale: §13.7 rule item 1 + normative statement: a call whose callee is server-placed SHALL NOT appear in a value position. Server data reaches markup through a `<request>` (§6.7.7).
